search_space: All 22 reduced nonzero rationals p/q with 1 <= |p| <= 4 and 1 <= q <= 4, q positive, exhaustively visited in fixed order by increasing |p|, negative sign before positive sign, then increasing q.
witness_description: x = -1. For every positive integer n, n/x = -n < 0.
refutation_explanation: A sequence tending to positive infinity must eventually exceed 0. For x = -1, n/x = -n never exceeds 0, so the substitution tends toward negative infinity instead and violates the universal claim.
